The '''Garqi system''' was a five-[[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]].<ref name="GATORW" /> It was located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Tadrin sector/Legends|Tadrin sector]].
